title: Creator Studio
summary: Creator Studio supports protected Chronicle authoring, graph editing, previews, and controlled archive actions.
subfeatures: Whole-Passage drag reordering and additive or range selection
Published Passage opening, leaving, and active-state motion presets
Plain-language validation findings with blocking and attention severity presentation

title: Twenty-Three-Type Story Block System
summary: Strict versioned contracts define all twenty-three Story Block types with canonical parsing and serialization, typed variables and bounded expressions, deterministic content migration, stable issues, and compatibility-safe validation.
subfeatures: Strict configuration, presentation, and completion contracts
Typed variable scopes, operations, usage indexing, and safe rename propagation
Typed deterministic expression AST, checking, and bounded evaluation
Versioned migration registry with frozen historical compatibility fixtures
Stable issues and incremental validation with current Studio and runtime compatibility
limitations: Whole-Chronicle static analysis, repair and waiver workflows, and simulation remain outside Phase 1.
Provider contracts without configured owner adapters remain explicitly unavailable.

title: Immutable Publishing, Editions, and Forks
summary: Published Chronicle versions are immutable checksummed editions that active Voyages can pin safely.

title: Asset Library and Media Pipeline
summary: Creators manage validated reusable assets and safe derivative media through a version-aware library.

title: Waypoint and Reference Library
summary: Reusable Waypoints and references support authored directions and future provider integration without exposing private notes.

title: Chronicle Artifact Definitions
summary: Creators define reusable artifacts with visual, collection, relationship, and published-edition metadata.

title: Authoritative Progression Engine
summary: One transaction-aware progression engine evaluates authored rules and emits ordered canonical Voyage events.

title: Tideglass Chronicle Edition Intelligence
summary: Tideglass compares exact immutable Chronicle editions, explains semantic change in an ordinary spoiler-safe What Changed experience, anchors comparison to a player's retained Voyage history, and gives Creator Studio the same canonical semantic truth without changing published or live Voyage state.
subfeatures: Stable change codes and explainable significance
Authorized bounded comparison and annotation APIs
Exact edition selection, pair swap, and Publishing-owned current target
Compare to What I Played using owner-bound retained Voyage history
Spoiler disclosure, concise/detailed modes, category filters, compatibility, and accessibility presentation
Creator Studio published-version comparison through canonical semantic projection
limitations: Unknown historical semantics remain explicitly unavailable until an accepted Drydock reader can normalize them.
Final Harborlight update integration and any accepted Captain/Helm visual comparison consumer remain deferred to later work.
The Wakebook Journey Detail handoff is owner-accepted in the current reconciliation candidate; it is not represented as accepted-main capability until protected integration completes.
